to: BYK/loreai maintainers or commercial team via the repository's public contact route
subject: Bounded ai-agents integration pilot for BYK/loreai
body:
Hello BYK/loreai maintainers,

I found BYK/loreai on GitHub's public AI-agents topic. Your project is described as “Your AI never starts over. Lore keeps sessions coherent for days and millions of tokens — no lossy summary that”. This is a speculative paid-pilot proposal, not a claim that you advertised a contract.

I prepared a five-minute, dependency-free demo that maps a small ai-agents workflow into three inspectable states: accepted input, refused input, and an exported receipt. For a TypeScript codebase, the proposed paid milestone would be deliberately narrow:

1. Identify one integration or verification seam maintainers currently test manually.
2. Implement a minimal adapter and a failing-path test without changing public APIs.
3. Deliver the patch, reproducible check, and short maintainer runbook.

Proof of delivery cadence: https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ contains 21 live browser games, and https://github.com/TTaoGaming/hfo-gen-133 exposes the append-only receipts and operator-gated effect model used to keep agent work auditable. I am proposing integration labor, not asking you to adopt the surrounding mythology or infrastructure.

If that seam is real for your roadmap, the attached demo is the conversation starter; otherwise no follow-up is needed.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
